mechanism.claim: A six-hour move that remains directionally concordant while average executed quote ticket expands in the final two hours is more likely sponsored than churn. Follow the common direction for twelve elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed early four-hour and late two-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: TECC uses within-BTC temporal expansion of quote volume per reported trade. It is not cross-asset ticket leadership, spot/perpetual count share, small-ticket exhaustion, taker imbalance, VWAP contradiction, funding, or a volatility threshold.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: sponsored ticket expansion should retain direction during volatile auctions; causal RV20 q90 is only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: strict-prior ticket-expansion tail plus concordance onset creates sparse state-dependent clocks rather than a fixed schedule

features.early_return: log(early last close/early first open), strict nonzero
features.late_return: log(late last close/late first open), strict nonzero
features.ticket_expansion_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 540 prior valid decision observations; minimum 360; current excluded
features.eligible_state: ticket expansion rank>=0.80 and early/late returns have the same sign
features.onset: eligible state true and immediately preceding 4-hour decision eligible state false
features.source_valid: exact unique minute grid, coherent finite positive OHLC, finite nonnegative quote volume, finite nonnegative integer trade counts, positive block quote volume and trade-count denominators; no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: exact 4-hour UTC boundary after all source bars complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.no_ticket_tail: same-sign early/late returns with positive raw ticket expansion onset
definitions.no_concordance: ticket-tail onset following the late return side without early/late sign agreement
definitions.early_ticket_dominance: same-sign returns with positive early-over-late ticket expansion in its strictly-prior top quintile onset, following the common return side

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no rank, history, onset, block, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
